confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from five searches of mostly undated or crowd-sourced sources, including cost-of-living sites, delivery-app menus, travel guides, and a 2011 and a 2016 item. They are rough estimates, not verified current menu prices. Beer, coffee and inexpensive-meal figures broadly agree across sources. Midrange meal, cocktail and wine figures rest on fewer and wider data points. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a non-peak July window and were not searched. FX is not verified as latest: the search budget ran out before a current RBA observation could be retrieved. The only RBA figure seen is 0.7088 USD per AUD for 2026-03-20, from a cached RBA page snapshot, so it is stale relative to 2026-11-19. Third-party sites showed about 0.68 in mid-November 2026, but those are not RBA observations and were not used. The server should check as_of_date against the generation date before conversion.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Siem Reap-specific aggregator and menu prices, cross-checked against a Cambodia-wide cost index. Accommodation anchors are a holistic model estimate informed by general Southeast Asian tourist-town guesthouse and hostel pricing. No accommodation search or live booking check was performed.
